general_wellness.name: General Daily Wellness
general_wellness.focus: Balanced baseline routine supporting recovery and energy

blocks.title: Wake and hydrate
blocks.detail: Drink 300-500 mL of water to rehydrate after sleep.

blocks.title: Light stretching
blocks.detail: 10 minutes of gentle full-body mobility work.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.detail: Balanced plate: protein, whole grains and fruit.

blocks.title: Mid-morning hydration
blocks.detail: One glass of water.

blocks.title: Focused work block
blocks.detail: Screen breaks every 45 minutes with a short walk.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Include vegetables and a protein source.

blocks.title: Short walk
blocks.detail: 15-20 minutes of light activity after eating.

blocks.title: Hydration and stretch
blocks.detail: Water plus 5 minutes of neck and shoulder release.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Lighter meal, finish 2-3 hours before bed.

blocks.title: Wind down
blocks.detail: Dim screens, relaxation breathing, prepare for sleep.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Target 7-9 hours in a cool, dark room.

respiratory_recovery.name: Respiratory Recovery Routine
respiratory_recovery.focus: Airway clearance, hydration and rest for cold, flu, COVID or bronchitis

blocks.title: Wake and warm fluids
blocks.detail: Warm water with lemon or herbal tea to loosen congestion.

blocks.title: Steam inhalation
blocks.detail: 10 minutes over a bowl of hot water (towel over head) or in a steamy shower.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.detail: Warm, easy-to-eat food such as porridge or eggs.

blocks.title: Salt-water gargle
blocks.detail: Half a teaspoon of salt in warm water for 30 seconds if throat is sore.

blocks.title: Rest block
blocks.detail: Lie down with your head slightly elevated.

blocks.title: Lunch and fluids
blocks.detail: Warm soup plus at least 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Chest clearance breathing
blocks.detail: 5 slow deep breaths, then a gentle huff cough. Repeat 3 times.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: Another 300-500 mL of fluid.

blocks.title: Second steam inhalation
blocks.detail: 10 minutes to ease evening congestion.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Light warm meal; avoid very cold drinks.

blocks.title: Evening medication and temperature check
blocks.detail: Take scheduled medicines and note your temperature.

blocks.title: Sleep with head elevated
blocks.detail: Extra pillow to reduce post-nasal drip at night.

gastro_recovery.name: Gastrointestinal Recovery Routine
gastro_recovery.focus: Rehydration and gut rest for diarrhoea, vomiting or gastroenteritis

blocks.title: Oral rehydration
blocks.detail: Sip 200 mL of ORS slowly. Do not gulp.

blocks.title: Bland breakfast
blocks.detail: Banana, plain rice or dry toast. Small portion.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: Another 200 mL of ORS or plain water.

blocks.title: Rest
blocks.detail: Lie down; keep warm.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 200 mL of fluid, sipped slowly.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Plain rice or khichdi with a little salt. Avoid dairy and oil.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 200 mL ORS. Replace losses after every loose stool.

blocks.title: Rest and monitor
blocks.detail: Track stool frequency and urine output.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 200 mL fluid.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Light, low-fat, low-fibre meal.

blocks.title: Medication
blocks.detail: Zinc, probiotics and prescribed medicines.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Keep fluids by the bed for night-time rehydration.

digestive_care.name: Digestive Care Routine
digestive_care.focus: Acid control and comfortable digestion for reflux, gastritis or ulcer

blocks.title: Wake and water
blocks.detail: 200-300 mL of water before anything else.

blocks.title: Morning walk
blocks.detail: 15 minutes of gentle walking to aid gut motility.

blocks.title: Breakfast (small)
blocks.detail: Avoid fried, spicy and very acidic foods. Oats or toast work well.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: Sip water between meals rather than during them.

blocks.title: Upright activity
blocks.detail: Stay upright for at least 2 hours after eating.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Small portion; avoid caffeine and carbonated drinks.

blocks.title: Walk, do not lie down
blocks.detail: 20-minute walk helps gastric emptying.

blocks.title: Light snack
blocks.detail: Small, low-fat snack if hungry. Avoid citrus.

blocks.title: Dinner (early)
blocks.detail: Finish at least 3 hours before lying down.

blocks.title: Evening walk
blocks.detail: 15 minutes of easy walking.

blocks.title: Medication and head elevation
blocks.detail: Take acid medication as prescribed; raise the head of the bed 15 cm.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Sleep on your left side to reduce reflux.

headache_management.name: Headache and Migraine Routine
headache_management.focus: Trigger control, hydration and a steady daily rhythm

blocks.title: Wake at a consistent time
blocks.detail: Regular wake times reduce migraine frequency.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 400 mL of water immediately on waking.

blocks.title: Neck and shoulder stretches
blocks.detail: 10 minutes of slow mobility work.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.detail: Do not skip meals - missed meals trigger headaches.

blocks.title: Screen break
blocks.detail: 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes look 20 feet away for 20 seconds.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Regular meal; note any food triggers in a diary.

blocks.title: Relaxation practice
blocks.detail: 10 minutes of slow breathing or progressive muscle relaxation.

blocks.title: Hydration and light activity
blocks.detail: Water plus a short walk.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Limit caffeine and alcohol, common triggers.

blocks.title: Dark, quiet wind-down
blocks.detail: Dim lights and screens to prevent evening triggers.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Same bedtime every night, including weekends.

joint_care.name: Joint and Musculoskeletal Routine
joint_care.focus: Mobility, strength and joint protection for arthritis, gout or fibromyalgia

blocks.title: Warm shower or bath
blocks.detail: Warmth reduces morning stiffness.

blocks.title: Range-of-motion exercises
blocks.detail: 10-15 minutes moving each joint gently through its full range.

blocks.title: Breakfast with anti-inflammatory foods
blocks.detail: Include omega-3 sources, fruit and whole grains.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water; important for gout (2-3 L per day).

blocks.title: Strengthening block
blocks.detail: Low-impact strengthening or physiotherapy exercises.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Balanced meal; limit red meat and shellfish if you have gout.

blocks.title: Rest with joint support
blocks.detail: Rest the most affected joint; use a splint if advised.

blocks.title: Swimming or cycling
blocks.detail: 20-30 minutes of low-impact aerobic activity.

blocks.title: Hot or cold pack
blocks.detail: 10-15 minutes on painful joints.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Anti-inflammatory plate; stay hydrated.

blocks.title: Medication and gentle stretch
blocks.detail: Take prescribed medicines and do a light stretch.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Supportive mattress; use pillows to keep joints neutral.

skin_care.name: Skin Care and Healing Routine
skin_care.focus: Barrier repair, infection control and itch management

blocks.title: Gentle cleanse
blocks.detail: Lukewarm water with a soap-free cleanser. Pat dry, do not rub.

blocks.title: Moisturise
blocks.detail: Apply emollient generously within 3 minutes of washing.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.detail: Include fruit, vegetables and adequate protein for skin repair.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water; keep the skin hydrated from within.

blocks.title: Medication application
blocks.detail: Apply prescribed creams in a thin layer to affected areas only.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Balanced meal; note any food triggers for flares.

blocks.title: Avoid scratching
blocks.detail: Use a cool compress or tap instead of scratching.

blocks.title: Hydration and loose clothing
blocks.detail: Water plus soft cotton clothing to reduce irritation.

blocks.title: Second moisturise
blocks.detail: Reapply emollient to dry areas.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Avoid known trigger foods during a flare.

blocks.title: Evening medication
blocks.detail: Night-time cream or antihistamine as prescribed.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Cotton bedding, cool room, nails trimmed short.

allergy_control.name: Allergy Control Routine
allergy_control.focus: Allergen avoidance and symptom prevention for hay fever and rhinitis

blocks.title: Check pollen forecast
blocks.detail: Plan outdoor activity around low-pollen times.

blocks.title: Saline nasal rinse
blocks.detail: Rinse each nostril to clear overnight allergens.

blocks.title: Breakfast and morning antihistamine
blocks.detail: Take a non-sedating antihistamine with breakfast if prescribed.

blocks.title: Keep windows closed
blocks.detail: Use air conditioning or a filter on high-pollen days.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Lunch indoors
blocks.detail: Eat indoors to limit pollen exposure.

blocks.title: Shower if outdoors
blocks.detail: Rinse pollen from skin and hair after being outside.

blocks.title: Nasal steroid spray
blocks.detail: Use the nasal steroid spray as prescribed for prevention.

blocks.title: Change clothes
blocks.detail: Remove outdoor clothes to avoid carrying pollen indoors.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Note any cross-reactive foods in a symptom diary.

blocks.title: Evening rinse
blocks.detail: Second saline rinse and eye drops if needed.

blocks.title: Sleep with windows shut
blocks.detail: Keep the bedroom allergen-reduced.

urinary_care.name: Urinary Tract Care Routine
urinary_care.focus: High fluid intake and bladder hygiene for UTI or kidney stones

blocks.title: Large glass of water
blocks.detail: 400 mL on waking to start bladder flushing.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.detail: Low-salt meal; limit oxalate-rich foods if you have stones.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Do not hold urine
blocks.detail: Empty the bladder fully and often.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Balanced meal; keep salt low.

blocks.title: Warm compress
blocks.detail: Apply to the lower abdomen for discomfort.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Light meal; avoid excess caffeine and alcohol.

blocks.title: Evening medication
blocks.detail: Take prescribed antibiotics and complete the full course.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Empty the bladder before bed; keep water nearby.

cardiac_care.name: Heart and Blood Pressure Routine
cardiac_care.focus: Blood pressure control, low-salt eating and graded activity

blocks.title: Wake and check blood pressure
blocks.detail: Sit quietly 5 minutes before measuring. Record the reading.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Morning medication
blocks.detail: Take blood pressure or heart medicines at the same time daily.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.detail: Low-salt, high-fibre plate. Avoid processed meats.

blocks.title: Graded walk
blocks.detail: 20-30 minutes at a pace where you can still talk.

blocks.title: Hydration and rest
blocks.detail: Water plus a short sit-down.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Under 5 g of salt per day in total; include vegetables.

blocks.title: Gentle activity
blocks.detail: Light stretching or a second short walk.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Dinner (light)
blocks.detail: Avoid heavy, salty meals in the evening.

blocks.title: Evening medication and weight check
blocks.detail: Take evening medicines; weigh yourself and record it.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: 7-8 hours; report breathlessness when lying flat.

metabolic_care.name: Metabolic and Blood Sugar Routine
metabolic_care.focus: Steady glucose, thyroid timing and consistent activity

blocks.title: Wake and hydrate
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water before breakfast.

blocks.title: Thyroid medication (if prescribed)
blocks.detail: Take levothyroxine on an empty stomach, 30-60 minutes before food.

blocks.title: Blood glucose check
blocks.detail: Test fasting glucose if advised and record it.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.detail: Low glycaemic index: whole grains, protein, vegetables.

blocks.title: Post-meal walk
blocks.detail: 15 minutes of walking lowers post-meal glucose.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Half plate vegetables, quarter protein, quarter whole grains.

blocks.title: Activity block
blocks.detail: 20-30 minutes of moderate exercise, 5 days a week.

blocks.title: Foot check
blocks.detail: Inspect feet for cuts, blisters or redness. Moisturise but not between toes.

blocks.title: Small balanced snack
blocks.detail: Only if needed to prevent a glucose dip.

blocks.title: Dinner (early, light)
blocks.detail: Avoid refined sugar and heavy late meals.

blocks.title: Evening medication
blocks.detail: Take diabetes medicines as prescribed with or after food.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Consistent sleep improves insulin sensitivity.

mental_wellbeing.name: Mental Wellbeing Routine
mental_wellbeing.focus: Mood, sleep hygiene and structured daily activity

blocks.title: Wake at a fixed time
blocks.detail: Get daylight within 30 minutes of waking.

blocks.title: Hydration and breathing
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water plus 5 minutes of slow breathing.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.detail: Regular meals stabilise mood and energy.

blocks.title: Outdoor walk
blocks.detail: 20-30 minutes of daylight and movement.

blocks.title: Structured task block
blocks.detail: One small, achievable goal written down and completed.

blocks.title: Lunch and connection
blocks.detail: Eat with or message someone supportive.

blocks.title: Pleasant activity
blocks.detail: Schedule one activity you enjoy, however small.

blocks.title: Hydration and movement
blocks.detail: Water plus a stretch break.

blocks.title: Worry time (bounded)
blocks.detail: Write worries down for 15 minutes, then close the notebook.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Regular evening meal; limit alcohol and caffeine.

blocks.title: Wind-down without screens
blocks.detail: Reading, music or gentle stretching.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Same bedtime nightly. Seek help immediately if you have thoughts of self-harm.

infectious_fever_care.name: Fever and Infection Care Routine
infectious_fever_care.focus: Fever monitoring, hydration and warning-sign surveillance

blocks.title: Temperature check
blocks.detail: Record your temperature and how you feel.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 400 mL of water or ORS.

blocks.title: Breakfast (light)
blocks.detail: Easily digestible food such as porridge or fruit.

blocks.title: Medication
blocks.detail: Paracetamol for fever as directed. Avoid NSAIDs if dengue is suspected.

blocks.title: Rest
blocks.detail: Lie down in a cool, ventilated room.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of fluid.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Light, warm meal.

blocks.title: Temperature and warning-sign check
blocks.detail: Check for bleeding, persistent vomiting, abdominal pain or drowsiness.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of fluid.

blocks.title: Rest and monitor urine output
blocks.detail: Aim for pale, regular urine. Report very little urine.

blocks.title: Dinner (light)
blocks.detail: Small warm meal.

blocks.title: Evening medication and temperature
blocks.detail: Take medicines and log the evening temperature.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.detail: Sleep near someone who can check on you overnight.

eye_care.name: Eye and Ear Care Routine
eye_care.focus: Hygiene, comfort and safe medication use for eye or ear infection

blocks.title: Warm water face wash
blocks.detail: Clean eyelids gently from inner to outer corner with cooled boiled water.

blocks.title: Medication drops
blocks.detail: Apply prescribed drops; do not touch the eye with the dropper.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.detail: Balanced meal; hydration supports healing.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.detail: 300 mL of water.

blocks.title: Cool compress
blocks.detail: 5-10 minutes over closed eyes for comfort.

blocks.title: Medication drops
blocks.detail: Second scheduled dose of the day.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.detail: Avoid rubbing the eyes; wash hands before eating.

blocks.title: Screen break
blocks.detail: Reduce screen time during infection; rest the eyes.

blocks.title: Medication drops
blocks.detail: Third scheduled dose.

blocks.title: Fresh towel
blocks.detail: Use a separate towel and change it daily to avoid reinfection.

blocks.title: Dinner
blocks.detail: Light meal.

blocks.title: Medication drops and sleep
blocks.detail: Final dose, then sleep with clean bedding.

blocks.title: Call emergency services
blocks.detail: Call your local emergency number immediately. Do not wait to see if symptoms settle.

blocks.title: Stay with the person
blocks.detail: Do not leave them alone. Keep them still and calm.

blocks.title: Note the time symptoms started
blocks.detail: This is critical for stroke and heart attack treatment decisions.

blocks.title: Do not give food or drink
blocks.detail: Especially if there is drowsiness, confusion or difficulty swallowing.

blocks.title: Follow dispatcher instructions
blocks.detail: They may guide you on CPR, recovery position or medication.

blocks.title: Do not drive yourself
blocks.detail: Wait for the ambulance or have someone else drive.
